title: fix-retry-after-ms-type-comparison
request: The _parse_retry_after function crashes when the retry-after-ms header is a string because it compares the string to 0. Update it to convert to int first and then compare.
reference_diff:
--- a/langfuse/api/core/http_client.py
+++ b/langfuse/api/core/http_client.py
@@ -32,7 +32,8 @@
     retry_after_ms = response_headers.get("retry-after-ms")
     if retry_after_ms is not None:
         try:
-            return int(retry_after_ms) / 1000 if retry_after_ms > 0 else 0
+            ms = int(retry_after_ms)
+            return ms / 1000 if ms > 0 else 0
         except Exception:
             pass
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_http_client_retry_after.py
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+import pytest
+from httpx import Headers
+
+from langfuse.api.core.http_client import _parse_retry_after
+
+
+def test_parse_retry_after_ms_string_returns_seconds():
+    headers = Headers({"retry-after-ms": "5000"})
+    assert _parse_retry_after(headers) == 5.0
+
+
+def test_parse_retry_after_ms_missing_returns_none():
+    headers = Headers({})
+    assert _parse_retry_after(headers) is None
